candidates.title: Claude Code 2.1.328
candidates.author: Anthropic
candidates.what_changed: Auto mode for Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 on Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry and Claude apps gateway; 'onFailure: block' for mcp_tool hooks; /code-review narrowed to bugs and CLAUDE.md violations with Important/Pre-existing/Nit labels (cleanups moved to /simplify); many Code Mode fixes and speedups.

Fixed zsh '=' word expansion bug; auto-compaction now rebuilds system prompt like /compact.
candidates.evidence_quality: Primary source changelog, read in full.
candidates.relevance: High for Claude Code users, especially Code Mode adopters and those on third-party clouds.
candidates.overlap_with_prior: Ed2 covered 2.1.326/2.1.327 and Code Mode launch; this is new.
candidates.summary: Same-day pair with 2.1.329. Key practitioner changes: auto mode on third-party providers for 4.6 models; MCP tool hooks can block on failure; /code-review now reports only bugs and CLAUDE.md violations, classifying findings; a long list of Code Mode maturity fixes (speed, caching, token use, hook semantics, edit failures); cross-session messaging and Remote Control fixes; extensive self-hosted runner additions.

candidates.title: Claude Code 2.1.329
candidates.author: Anthropic
candidates.what_changed: Trust dialog now names where a folder's hooks are declared; /tasks lists scheduled tasks, /loop wakeups, goal and forks; /mcp shows a remote server's JSON-RPC refusal message; Code Mode allowed with OpenTelemetry events/metrics; /code-review with no target reviews whole branch vs default branch.
candidates.mechanism: Code Mode: an erroring PreToolUse hook no longer refuses a script's tool call (set onFailure: block to keep refusal); reads over 256 MiB line range refused; starts even with telemetry/feature flags off (admins can disable in managed settings). Removed 2.1.326's automatic retry at the max_tokens limit (gateway users set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS). Saved scheduled tasks from earlier versions mostly need rescheduling in new signed-in sessions. macOS computer use updated to newer safety rules. Fixed ~/.claude.json reset-to-defaults on network stall/file lock.
candidates.evidence_quality: Primary source changelog, read.
candidates.relevance: High; includes behaviour changes users must act on (hooks onFailure, scheduled tasks rescheduling, max_tokens retry removal).
candidates.overlap_with_prior: New since Ed2 (which covered up to 2.1.327).
candidates.summary: Second Nov 19 release. Notable breaking/behaviour changes: Code Mode hook-failure semantics now match non-Code-Mode (opt in to blocking), scheduled tasks saved by earlier versions need rescheduling, removed max_tokens auto-retry from 2.1.326, /code-review default target is the whole branch.
